messages:
Maya Rao: Quick heads-up — PR 22411 is sitting with a failing QA smoke. mac-e2e keeps flaking with a 5xx on /v1/generate, holding landing for now. need a rerun or a quick triage. :thinking_face:
Jon Park: On it, kicking a mac matrix rerun now (/ci rerun mac-e2e). will report back in ~10m. :hourglass:
Priya Nair: QA repro steps look intermittent — hitting a race when cache warmup is slow. adding logs to the job to see timing.
Kevin Liu: If reruns keep failing and we hit the midnight deploy freeze, can we land to the dedicated pool as a canary and route low-traffic traffic there? avoids the full prod push.
Maya Rao: Good idea. If we go dedicated-canary we'll need an approval and a short rollout plan. @Release Bot can you confirm dedicated pool availability tonight?
Release Bot: Dedicated pool availability: slot free until 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z. Deploy freeze starts 2026-03-19T00:00:00Z — immediate canaries allowed but no full-prod push during freeze.
Jon Park: mac-e2e rerun finished — still one 5xx, logs attached in CI build. I'm going to re-run with increased timeouts for the KV warmup.
QA Bot: Smoke suite result: 3 failures (intermittent 5xx), 12 passed. Marked flaky. Recommendation: hold for another green run or proceed with canary to dedicated.
Priya Nair: Rebase to main would help (there's a small fix in main for the warmup ordering). I can do the rebase now, should be quick.
Maya Rao: OK Priya please rebase and ping when done. If Jon gets a green run before freeze we can land normally. If not, we'll canary to dedicated and notify CS.
Kevin Liu: I'll draft the canary rollout steps: 1) land to dedicated pool 2) route 2% traffic for 15m 3) monitor errors/latency 4) ramp or rollback. Will post as a checklist in the PR when ready.
Maya Rao: Thanks all. Priya/ Jon — ping back here when rebase or green run complete. If we end up canarying, I'll request an approval from @Release Bot + @Kevin Liu.
Priya Nair: Rebase done and pushed (force-pushed onto PR branch). CI triggered. cc @Jon Park
Jon Park: New run is green on mac-e2e. QA smoke now green. Maya, you good to land before freeze?
Maya Rao: Yes — green smoke, approvals in place. Landing now to main. Will follow the usual short canary on hosted then full rollout (no dedicated fallback needed). Thanks everyone. :rocket:
